modules.title: Carry-on

carryon_bag_dimensions.notes: Aklak Air cabin baggage size limit: 55 x 40 x 20 cm.

weight_economy.notes: Aklak Air Economy Class carry-on weight limit.

weight_business_first.notes: Aklak Air Premium / Business Class carry-on weight limit.

cabin_items.value: Books, magazines, binoculars, coats and ladies' purses are not counted as personal baggage for weight purposes and may be carried in the cabin, at your own risk, without additional charge. The policy page gives no cabin bag size or weight limit.

modules.lede: Aklak Air restricts the weight, size and character of baggage according to the capacity of the particular aircraft.

modules.title: Checked baggage
modules.lede: Aklak Air restricts the weight, size and character of baggage according to the capacity of the particular aircraft.

free_allowance.value: Unless specifically provided otherwise, the free baggage allowance on any full or reduced fare is 30 kilograms. Passengers buying two tickets for single occupancy are allowed 60 kilograms.

excess_baggage.value: Excess baggage travels subject to space available; excess charges are determined at check-in.
